Account summary:
- Long-standing customer using Redwood hosted API for chat/support since 2022.
- Current contract up for renewal Q2 2026; primary ask is move from burst-hosted to Dedicated to stabilize latency & unit cost.
- Primary workloads: high-concurrency support-agent chat (multi-turn), embeddings for search, reranking for ticket routing, nightly summarization jobs.
- Latency/throughput targets: 99th pct < 200ms for short chat turns, median ~50ms; sustained concurrent sessions 3k+ in NA peak, EU 500-700, APAC pilot 200.
- Cost sensitivity: wants predictable monthly commit; estimating break-even vs hosted at ~150k tokens/day.

- Security: SSO + SCIM required, SOC2 attestation necessary, KMS integration for customer-managed keys, audit log retention 2 years, data residency clause for EU and APAC.
- Interesting cross-sell: Redwood Optimize to reduce token unit cost via batching & quantization suggestions; optimize adoption expected to save ~20-30% on inference spend.
- Quote from Dir of Platform: "We need consistent p95 latency and a billing model we can forecast across regions. If Redwood can prove APAC capacity and residency, we'll consolidate more workloads."
- Internal champion: Head of ML Ops (Sofia Marin) - technical lead, pushed for Dedicated. Procurement lead: Evan Brooks.
- Risks: legal wants explicit deletion/retention clause; finance pushing for blended ARR discount which delays signature.
- Recent wins: POC showed stable quality after 4-bit quantization for embed models; SE running additional throughput tests this week.
- Next tacticals: finalize GPU SKUs and regional sizing, run APAC latency pilot on partner infra, schedule Optimize workshop (2-day) for ML Ops + infra teams.
